vabpnn.name: VABPnn Continuous GPU Capture
message.vabpnn.continuous_on: Continuous capture and CUDA processing resumed
message.vabpnn.continuous_off: Capture and training paused; model inputs released
message.vabpnn.model_on: Continuous control: neural weights frozen, salience and connections dynamic; no confidence threshold gate
message.vabpnn.demo_on: Switched to human demonstration; model inputs released
message.vabpnn.save_requested: Model and optimizer save requested; completion will be reported
message.vabpnn.hotkeys: %s meme window / %s network window / %s frozen evaluation and control / %s pause / %s save
message.vabpnn.welcome: Standby. Enter /vabpnn start to begin capture and training; %s.
message.vabpnn.help: Start with /vabpnn start; hotkeys: %s, configurable in Controls.
message.vabpnn.commands: Commands: /vabpnn start for demonstrations; /vabpnn start predict for frozen prediction from the first frame; /vabpnn predict [on|off]; /vabpnn stop; /vabpnn status; /vabpnn save; /vabpnn hud [on|off].
message.vabpnn.save_pending: A save is still pending; its result will appear here.
message.vabpnn.save_unavailable: The model is not started or ready to save. Use /vabpnn start, then check /vabpnn status.
message.vabpnn.save_finished: Model, optimizer and training counters saved successfully.
message.vabpnn.save_failed: Save failed: %s. Press the save key to retry.
message.vabpnn.pipeline_failed: Pipeline stopped; model inputs released: %s. Use /vabpnn start to retry.
message.vabpnn.model_new: Using a fresh model; provide human demonstrations first.
message.vabpnn.model_restored: Existing model, optimizer and connections restored. Check /vabpnn status for the current mode.
message.vabpnn.hud_off: Live action-bar status disabled; hotkey messages remain in chat.
message.vabpnn.mode.model: Continuous control / weights frozen / topology dynamic
message.vabpnn.status.gpu: Processed %s / dropped %s | GPU operator last %s ms / max %s ms / over 10 ms: %s
message.vabpnn.status.learning: Valid demonstrations %s | Pixel %s / decision %s / JEPA %s / mouse %s steps | Checkpoint: %s
message.vabpnn.started: Pipeline started in human demonstration mode; use the mode key for model control.
message.vabpnn.resumed: Capture and model pipeline resumed; the current mode is preserved.
message.vabpnn.already_started: The pipeline is already running; the current mode is unchanged.
message.vabpnn.start_unavailable: The client is closing; the pipeline cannot be started.
message.vabpnn.stopped: Pipeline stopped; model inputs released. Use /vabpnn start to restart.
message.vabpnn.already_stopped: The pipeline is not started. Use /vabpnn start to begin.
message.vabpnn.not_started: Enter /vabpnn start before using the pipeline hotkeys.
message.vabpnn.state.idle_threshold: Control connected; no action exceeds its learned threshold
message.vabpnn.state.idle: Control connected; no action in this frame
message.vabpnn.status.decision: Decision frame: %s | learned k=%s | candidates: %s | selected %s | latest human label: %s
message.vabpnn.status.mouse: Real mouse demonstrations: left presses %s / right presses %s / left releases %s / right releases %s (including inventory)
message.vabpnn.model_idle: %s; k=%s, candidates: %s. Prediction continues; /vabpnn status shows learning and control.
message.vabpnn.status.time: Time axes: %s seconds / %s minutes | Observed minute buckets %s / 8 | Minute attention training %s steps / Bayesian mouse training %s steps
message.vabpnn.status.position: Player XYZ: %s / %s / %s | Target 30 Hz | %s | Position training steps: %s
message.vabpnn.meme_scope_on: Meme propagation window shown; sampling at 5 Hz
message.vabpnn.meme_scope_off: Meme propagation window hidden; sampling stopped
message.vabpnn.predict_started: Prediction-only started: neural weights frozen, salience/topology dynamic, no injected input; observe with F6/F7
message.vabpnn.predict_on: Prediction-only: neural weights frozen, salience/topology dynamic, owned input released; predict off restores demonstration, F8 starts continuous control
message.vabpnn.predict_already: Prediction-only is active: neural weights frozen, topology dynamic, no injected input
message.vabpnn.predict_inactive: Prediction-only is not active; the current mode is unchanged
message.vabpnn.mode.predict: Prediction only / weights frozen / topology dynamic / no input
message.vabpnn.state.prediction_waiting: predict only; waiting for a fresh proposal
message.vabpnn.status.prediction: Proposal frame: %s | objects: %s | dx %s, dy %s, wheel %s (proposals and applied input are separate)
message.vabpnn.hud.predict: Predict only · %s · proposal: %s · dx %s / dy %s · GPU %s ms
